marketplace-visible.label: marketplace-visible
marketplace-visible.description: Tracked plugin skills reachable from canonical marketplace catalog source roots; hidden adapter trees, the root curriculum, and the curated mirror are excluded.

graded.label: graded
graded.description: Tracked plugin, curriculum, and legacy skills eligible for the grading harness after governed exclusions.

first-party.label: first-party
first-party.description: Tracked plugin skills whose filesystem ancestry has no applicable upstream source record.

curated-mirror.label: curated-mirror
curated-mirror.description: Tracked skills in skills/.curated whose membership exactly matches the governed curated manifest.

curriculum.label: curriculum
curriculum.description: Tracked skills in the numbered root curriculum, excluding experimental material.

surfaces.reason: The Cowork archive count comes from cowork-manifest.json and currently has hard-coded fallbacks; it is not the marketplace-visible cohort.
Per-bundle counts are derived from Cowork manifest entries and require a separate packaged-cohort contract.
The generated image must carry a legible cohort and reproduction locator without duplicating the registry wording.
